description: ERP shift calendar (GET /api/calendar -> week_pattern): per department x ISO weekday x shift the working-time window and its breaks. Supersedes the pre-next2.0 descriptor of the same sourceId, which was never in the active source set — it targeted the retired SMProfile-ShiftWindow under profiles/business/ and declared a `syntheticId` key that NO service implements (grepped across all of i3x-v4 services/ on 2026-08-03: zero hits), so it would have been accepted by source-schema.json (additionalProperties: true) and silently ignored at runtime. This descriptor uses `primaryKeyColumns`, which the it-edge really honours via change-detect.pkOf/encodeCompositePk. THE CALENDAR IS THE ANSWER TO 'WAS ANYTHING SUPPOSED TO RUN?': without it a consumer cannot separate an unscheduled hour from a failed one, and a weekend reads as an outage — see the profile description for the measurement that forced this source into the active set. full_refresh: the endpoint serves the complete 45-row week pattern on every call and honours no `since` param (verified 2026-08-03); the it-edge dedups via the per-key HWM, so a pattern that does not change emits nothing. Polled hourly — this is master data that changes when the plant changes its shift model, not per shift.
